mappings.title: Missing golden vector test
mappings.notes: Genuinely new finding. Premortem S5/S6 identified this but no test was written. External review independently rediscovered.

mappings.title: Missing non-canonical field exclusion test
mappings.notes: Genuinely new finding. The struct exhaustiveness test partially covers this, but a dedicated non-canonical test would strengthen documentation of the invariant.

mappings.title: intent_hash_ih16 function semantics mismatch
mappings.false_positive_justification: xxhash64 is 64 bits = 16 hex characters. ih16 IS the full hash representation. The naming is accurate, not misleading. CONTRACT.md S1.1.2 says 'ih16 = first 16 chars of intent_hash' which is all 16 chars for xxhash64. No action needed.

mappings.title: Documentation/implementation mismatch qty_q vs qty_steps
mappings.false_positive_justification: The doc comment already explains the divergence from CONTRACT notation. The premortem S4 Decision 1 explicitly chose integer steps/ticks. The implementation is correct and documented. Minor doc improvement only -- not a contract gap.

mappings.title: No observability on hash computation
mappings.false_positive_justification: The hash function is a pure computation with no failure modes. Adding feature-gated tracing for debug builds is a nice-to-have but not a contract requirement. Hash divergence would be caught by the determinism tests. No AT requires hash observability.

mappings.title: AT-201 should be contextual, not enforcing
mappings.notes: Identical to R1 finding GAP-S2-001-1. Added kimi-enriched to confirmed_by.

mappings.title: AT-343 partial coverage (missing cross-restart, non-canonical field tests)
mappings.notes: Cross-restart deferred per premortem (S6-001 downstream). Non-canonical field split into GAP-S2-001-7. Golden vector split into GAP-S2-001-6.

mappings.title: AT-218 partial (not truly different codepaths)
mappings.false_positive_justification: test_at218_two_codepaths_same_hash constructs two independent IntentHashInput instances with the same field values. AT-218 says: 'Given two codepaths compute the same intent fields, When intent_hash is generated, Then both hashes are identical.' The test directly implements this. The R1 verdict PROVEN is accurate.

mappings.title: Wrong implementation gates -- multiple gaps in S5 table
mappings.notes: The S5 table in kimi-enriched lists gaps for algorithm mismatch, 32-bit hash, DefaultHasher -- all caught by the same golden vector test (GAP-S2-001-6).

mappings.title: Missing input validation for negative quantities/prices
mappings.false_positive_justification: The hash function is a pure computation defined for all i64 values. Input validation (rejecting negative quantities) is the upstream quantization layer's responsibility (S2-000). The hash function should not reject inputs -- it hashes whatever it receives deterministically. R1 Section 5 (Fail-Closed) correctly classified negative values as N/A for this pure function. Kimi-generic mis-scoped the responsibility boundary.

mappings.title: test_at343_no_timestamp_field is fragile
mappings.false_positive_justification: The struct literal exhaustiveness check is a standard Rust pattern. If someone adds an Option<Instant> field with a default, the struct literal syntax without that field will fail to compile (Rust does not auto-fill missing fields). The mem::size_of suggestion is less robust than the current approach. The test is not fragile.

mappings.title: Missing hash collision resistance test
mappings.false_positive_justification: Collision resistance is an intrinsic property of xxhash64, not something S2-001 needs to prove. The field boundary separation test (test_field_boundary_separation) already proves that the concatenation strategy does not create artificial collisions. Property-based testing for collision resistance is an unbounded requirement not specified by any AT.

mappings.title: Buffer pre-allocation is wasteful (Vec::with_capacity(128))
mappings.false_positive_justification: Code quality observation, not a contract gap. 128 bytes vs 96 bytes of pre-allocation has zero safety impact. The buffer is local and temporary. Not tracked as a gap.

mappings.title: No validation of side field values
mappings.false_positive_justification: The hash function accepts any &str for side. Input validation (restricting to Buy/Sell) is the caller's responsibility. The hash function is correct for all string inputs. Using a Side enum would be an API design improvement tracked outside this story's scope.

mappings.title: Function name intent_hash_ih16 is misleading
mappings.false_positive_justification: Same finding as KIMI-E-3. Already dispositioned as false positive.

mappings.title: Missing documentation on separator choice
mappings.false_positive_justification: The 0xFF separator is documented inline at hash.rs:40. The test_field_boundary_separation test exists. Adding a cross-reference to the test from the comment is a minor doc improvement, not a contract gap.

mappings.title: crate_bootstrapped() placeholder without purpose
mappings.false_positive_justification: Out of scope for S2-001. crate_bootstrapped() is in lib.rs (crate root) and predates the idempotency module. It is not part of the hash function implementation.
